title: malaxis hastilabia var. major
intro: Malaxis hastilabia var. major, commonly known as the Malaxis orchid or Green Adder's-mouth orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Malaxis hastilabia var. major include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are beneficial for treating fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, demulcent, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
